name: Reliance Industries

snapshot.about: Reliance Industries Limited operates across oil-to-chemicals, digital services, retail, financial services, exploration & production, and new energy.

narrative: Management reported strong growth, with Q2 FY27 revenue surging 29.8% to ₹330,601 crore and net profit rising 33.8% to ₹29,550 crore. O2C EBITDA grew 69% in Q2, while FMCG growth slowed sharply from 100% in Q1 to 60% in Q2.

promises.statement: Battery manufacturing capacity will reach 40 GWh this year, with plans to scale to 120 GWh.

said.quote: We will achieve 40-gigawatt hour capacity this year and we have announced the scale￾up through our AGM up to 120-gigawatt hour capacity

actual_source.quote: On the battery side, in next half year we will commission our BESS facility, which is a pack and container up to 40-gigawatt hour

promises.statement: New Energy segment is on track to achieve 20 GW annual integrated solar PV capacity.

said.quote: And we are on track, and I have got a few pictures to also demonstrate that, to achieve 20-gigawatt annual capacity for our solar PV manufacturing in an integrated fashion

actual_source.quote: as indicated, I think our module capacity is now six plus gigawatt, and we will be achieving up to 20 gigawatt early next year

promises.statement: First-half FY27 performance tracks an annualized O2C EBITDA of well over Rs 80,000 crore.

said.quote: So, when you look at the first half of FY 2027 performance, it is in our minds tracking annualized EBITDA well over Rs.80,000 Crores

promises.statement: New energy generation capacity will start coming up over the next 12 to 15 months.

said.quote: Yes, during next 12 to 15 months our generation capacity will also start coming up

actual_source.quote: as indicated, I think our module capacity is now six plus gigawatt, and we will be achieving up to 20 gigawatt early next year

promises.statement: Earnings contribution from the new energy segment is expected to begin in FY28.

said.quote: And on new energy, I just wanted to say that it is accelerating and we see the benefit, earnings contribution definitely starting in FY 2028

promises.statement: Retail business targets doubling absolute EBITDA over the next three years.

said.quote: What we are saying is we are looking to double our absolute EBITDA number

promises.statement: FMCG business targets reaching Rs. 1 lakh crore in revenue by FY30.

said.quote: we have anyway announced the target is to kind of take this to Rs.1 lakh Crores on FY2030

promises.statement: Solar cell manufacturing capacity will expand to 20 GW in H1 CY2027.

said.quote: Similarly, solar cell is now nearing around 5-gigawatt and we will be achieving again 20-gigawatt capacity sometime first half next year

promises.statement: The company expects to commission its BESS pack and container facility up to 40 GWh in H2 CY2027.

said.quote: On the battery side, in next half year we will commission our BESS facility, which is a pack and container up to 40-gigawatt hour

promises.statement: Solar module capacity will reach 20 GW early next calendar year (early 2027).

said.quote: as indicated, I think our module capacity is now six plus gigawatt, and we will be achieving up to 20 gigawatt early next year

promises.statement: Company is on track to commission its first fully integrated 10 GW peak solar gigafactory.

said.quote: We are well on our track to commission our first fully integrated 10-gigawatt peak annual solar manufacturing gigafactory and we have already announced that we are scaling this up to 20-gigawatt peak annual capacity

actual_source.quote: And we are on track, and I have got a few pictures to also demonstrate that, to achieve 20-gigawatt annual capacity for our solar PV manufacturing in an integrated fashion

bull.point: Consolidated EBITDA for Q2 FY27 grew 24% year-on-year to ₹62,409 crore, while net profit rose 34% to nearly ₹30,000 crore.

evidence.quote: It was an EBITDA of Rs.62,409 Crores, which is 24% up on a year-on￾year basis
and simultaneously, the PAT also at close to Rs.30,000 Crores, up 34%

bull.point: O2C segment EBITDA expanded 69% year-on-year in Q2 FY27 to ₹25,203 crore, pushing H1 annualized run-rate above ₹80,000 crore.

evidence.quote: Rs.25,203 Crores in terms of O2C EBITDA. As I mentioned, 69% higher, one of the strongest that we have seen
So, when you look at the first half of FY 2027 performance, it is in our minds tracking annualized EBITDA well over Rs.80,000 Crores

bear.point: Government of India issued a demand letter for 1.87 billion dollars RIL share following Delhi High Court setting aside the Gas Migration Arbitration Award.

evidence.quote: A demand letter dated 1st March 2025 for payment of $ 2.81 billion (RIL share $ 1.87 billion) was sent by GoI to the Contractor

bear.point: Disallowance of certain costs under the Production Sharing Contract for Block KG-DWN-98/3 remains an active key legal dispute.

evidence.quote: Disallowance of certain costs under the Production Sharing Contract (PSC), relating to Block KG‑DWN-98/3 and consequent deposit of differential revenue on gas sales from D1D3 field
